user.title: Apple TV Plus
user.description: Connect Apple TV Plus to your existing Home Assistant Apple TV media player. You can add custom sources afterward from Configure.

data_description.media_player_entity: The media player entity created by Home Assistant's native Apple TV integration — only Apple TVs are listed here.
data_description.device_id: Optional. The matching device entry for that SAME Apple TV, used for Fast Sleep and Home Screen commands. If you have more than one Apple TV, make sure this is the device for the one you picked above, not a different one.

abort.already_configured: This Apple TV is already set up.

add_source.title: Add a custom source
add_source.description: Name is what shows up in the source list on the media player. Target is either an app's bundle ID (e.g. com.netflix.Netflix) or a URL/deep link (e.g. youtube://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID) — anything containing "://" is treated as a link, anything else as an app.

data.name: Name
data.favorite: Favorite (shows with a ★ at the top of the source list)

data_description.name: What you'll see in the source list, e.g. "Severance" or "Netflix".
data_description.target: Either an app bundle ID like com.netflix.Netflix, or a full URL/deep link like https://tv.apple.com/show/... or youtube://...
data_description.favorite: Favorites sort to the top of the source list, including in Apple Home's TV input picker.
